propositions: BindingStore currently embeds forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, and unretire logic that should be extracted into a cohesive lifecycle policy owner.
Production rich-text convergence mutates BindingStore inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings(), bypassing any future policy seam and requiring a new narrow mutation operation.

Lifecycle policy operations must maintain at-most-one identity invariant through targeted single-key reverse pops, preserve all existing facade signatures and all_bindings() semantics, and never obtain direct repository write access to non-facade callers.

The narrow rich-emit operation (BindingStore.note_rich_emit) must match current hash/counter/save behavior, treat missing bindings as nonfatal, and become the supported production mutation seam for later caller cutover.

Existing failure modes must be preserved exactly: confirmed 404 grace/reset, moved-key repair, retired corruption fail-open, live corruption fail-closed, append-only comment identity, and tombstone suppression/unretire.
Legacy entries without numeric-ID field and tombstoned issues must remain readable without rewrite, with tombstones suppressing recreate until explicit unretire.
